exceptions.reason: JS accepts UI _localStaged or provenance alone; native custody/receipt and exact selected byte identity must prove ownership.
JS checks current generation or a row/ledger Graph ID, not original selected generation/origin/provider/byte proof. Missing Message-ID itself must remain supported with native proof.
deleteEmail is mocked here. Legacy adapter may broad EXPUNGE without UIDPLUS; bound native purge must refuse before STORE and preserve unrelated Deleted messages.
JS sees checkMailboxStatus/deleteEmail only. Actual JMAP remove-label, destroy-last, Gone handling and ledger retention are behind the API and must be tested natively; no invented JMAP trace.
These are scripted backupPurgeUids replies. Actual native configured/unavailable queue insertion versus unconfigured no-op and native bookmark/root ownership require native tests.
The thrown vault reply characterizes counters and the following mirror attempt. Actual partial file removal, byte safety, registry/custody state and storage-format support need native IO tests.
The existing test resolver chooses row _graphId then mocked ledger. Native original ID validation, collisions, relist and actual DELETE-to-Deleted-Items semantics are separate acceptance.
